messages:
kai: hey all :wave: first-day onboarding question. trying to spin up a tiny test vm in project redwood-temp-asia (asia-southeast1) and i'm hitting two blockers: 'Region not enabled for project' in the GCP console and a CPUS quota error when I try a different zone. also when I try to assume the AWS onboarding role I get an external-id mismatch. who should I loop in to attach billing, enable region, and validate the AWS trust?

marta: welcome kai! short checklist: 1) people-ops billing invite accepted? 2) org-policy might disallow asia-southeast1 by default for sandbox projects (need infra exception) 3) AWS external-id mismatch usually means the role expects a different value than you're sending. paste commands and errors?

kai: thanks. gcloud command i ran:
```
gcloud compute instances create tiny-asia --project=redwood-temp-asia --zone=asia-southeast1-b --machine-type=e2-small
```
console messages: "Region not enabled for project" (when using asia-southeast1) and when i tried europe-west1 zone it said: "Quota 'CPUS' exceeded for region europe-west1."
aws command i tried:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::777666555444:role/Redwood-Onboard --role-session-name kai-local --external-id abc-123-xyz
```
and the CLI returned: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: External ID does not match the role's configured external ID."

cloud-ops: thanks for the details. GCP: region enablement is an org-policy + billing mapping thing. infra can grant a temporary allowedRegion or attach billing if invite acceptance was via forwarding (known edge case). For quotas we can add a small vCPU bump for onboarding projects. AWS: DM the full role arn to us; we'll fetch the AssumeRolePolicyDocument to see the expected ExternalId. Quick tip: make sure your AWS profile is `onboarding` (or pass --profile onboarding) — we've had folks accidentally use default creds.

people-ops: hi Kai 64f i sent the billing invite on day 0. sometimes it lands in the Promotions tab. re-sent the invite to your work email just now. if you accepted and the project still shows unlinked, reply here and infra will attach billing. billing-account for onboarding projects: 2222-3333-4444.

kai: accepted the resend (it was in Promotions). i retried the gcloud describe:
```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-temp-asia
```
output: "billingAccountName: \"\"" (still empty). also checked `gcloud config list` and my account is correct. DM'd cloud-ops the role arn.

infra-setup-bot: ticket created: INF-9402. Actions: 1) attach billing-account 2222-3333-4444 to project redwood-temp-asia, 2) add 8 vCPUs to europe-west1 for onboarding tests, 3) request temporary org-policy exception to allow asia-southeast1 for 24 hours (requestor=kai). Priority=high for new hire onboarding. ETA 3 hours. For AWS external-id: cloud-ops will inspect trust policy; paste role arn or DM us if you want infra to coordinate.

cloud-ops: inspected trust policy for arn:aws:iam::777666555444:role/Redwood-Onboard. It expected external-id: "onboard-2025-xyz" not the "abc-123-xyz" you sent. We updated the onboarding doc to include the expected external-id and granted a short-term patch to accept the provided external-id while infra rotates the trust policy. Try the assume-role again with the onboarding profile.

kai: retried AWS with `--profile onboarding` and external-id onboard-2025-xyz and it worked! got temporary creds. thanks cloud-ops.

infra-setup-bot: update INF-9402: billing attached to redwood-temp-asia and org-policy exception granted for asia-southeast1 for 24 hours. vCPU quota increased by 8 in europe-west1. Ticket resolved.

kai: confirmed GCP now shows billing linked and i was able to create the VM in asia-southeast1: `gcloud compute instances create tiny-asia --project=redwood-temp-asia --zone=asia-southeast1-b --machine-type=e2-small` succeeded. also ran a quick end-to-end test that assumes the onboarding role and hits a test endpoint 680 all green. huge thanks everyone :tada::relieved:

marta: welcome aboard Kai! glad it's unblocked. If you need persistent access to asia-southeast1 for longer tests, file the infra form and include justification; infra will consider permanent policy change for your project. :+1:
